resale_co.name: Certificate of Occupancy (C/O inspection)
resale_co.issued_by: Elk Township Construction Office, Housing Official
resale_co.lead_time: 30 days advance notice before settlement is required
resale_co.valid_for: 3 months if the property is occupied, 6 months if vacant
requirements: Well water: passing test by an NJDEP certified lab (Private Well Testing Act), or County Health letter for a new well
Septic: Gloucester County Health Dept letter of Compliance-No Further Action, or License to Operate for a new system
Cesspools, privies and outhouses must be replaced with a septic system before transfer (limited exceptions)
Smoke detector in each bedroom and on every level (10 year sealed device)
Smoke and CO detectors outside bedrooms, within 10 feet of bedrooms
General condition of interior, exterior, grounds and accessory buildings (sheds, barns, garages)
Roofing, siding, trim, window glass, screens and doors
Pipes and traps under sinks; heater and water heater
Chimney condition; chimney certification for wood fireplaces, wood stoves or pellet stoves
GFCI outlets within 6 feet of water in kitchens, bathrooms and laundry
Township-issued trash and recycling containers on the premises

fees.label: First and second inspection
fees.quote: FEE: $100.00, 1 5t & 2nd inspection, (checks made payable to "Elk Township")

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Certificate of Occupancy Application and give it to the Construction Office at 680 Whig Lane, Monroeville (in person, in the vestibule drop box, or by mail) with a check payable to 'Elk Township'. Apply at least 30 days before settlement. Inspections are Mondays and Wednesdays; late applications get no special treatment. If the home is sold 'as is', the buyer can sign the Township's notarized as-is letter agreeing to finish repairs within 60 days, and the Township then issues a Settlement Document.

resale_co.notes: Form is marked 'Revised: March 2025' (PDF modified 2025-10-31) and is linked from the Township 'Find Municipal Forms' page. The fee line prints '1 5t' (a typo for 1st). The old link https://elktownshipnj.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Certificate-of-Occupancy-Application.pdf now returns 404. The Construction page lists the Housing Inspector (Gene Sherban) hours as Mon, Wed, Thurs 9am to 12pm. Rentals built before 1978 also need a lead-based paint safe certification and landlord registration (rental only).

requirements: Township CO form: smoke detector in each bedroom and on every level of the house, 10 year sealed device
Township CO form: smoke and CO detectors outside bedrooms within 10 feet of bedrooms

authorities.name: Elk Township Construction Office, Housing Official (smoke and CO alarms checked on the resale C/O inspection)
authorities.lead_time: 30 days before settlement (same as the C/O inspection)
authorities.how_to_apply: No separate smoke certificate application was found. The smoke and CO alarm check is part of the Township C/O inspection. Under N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.3(a)1, where a town has its own resale inspection, a separate certificate is not required but the town may not issue its CO until the home meets N.J.A.C. 5:70-4.19. Ask the Construction Office whether a portable fire extinguisher is also checked, since the form does not mention one.

evidence.quote: Smoke detector required in each bedroom and on every level of house (10 yr sealed device)

Where a municipality has existing inspection or approval requirements under a property maintenance or other municipal code, a CSACMAPFEC shall not be required; provided, however, that the agency responsible for the enforcement of that code shall not issue any certificate of inspection or occupancy or other approval under such municipal code until it has determined that the dwelling complies with the requirements of N.J.A.C. 5:70-4.19.

fire_cert.notes: The Uniform Fire Code local enforcing agency for Elk is the Gloucester County Fire Marshal's Office (DCA LEA Registry, third quarter, July 2026: 'C Elk Township'; County page https://gloucestercountynj.gov/1139/County-Fire-Marshall also lists Elk; 212 County House Road, Clarksboro, 856-307-7912, gcfmo@co.gloucester.nj.us). No County resale smoke certificate form or fee was found. Elk has no fire district; its fire companies are Aura and Ferrell. The Elk CO form does not mention a portable fire extinguisher. N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.3 text was read from the Cornell LII copy of the NJ Administrative Code.

other_items.label: Well water test
other_items.detail: Passing well water test by an NJDEP certified lab (NJAC 7:9E, Private Well Testing Act), or County Health Dept approval letter for a new well.

other_items.label: Septic certification / cesspool replacement
other_items.detail: Gloucester County Health Dept letter of Compliance-No Further Action (or License to Operate for new systems). Cesspools, privies and outhouses must be replaced with a septic system on transfer, with limited exceptions (NJAC 7:9A-3.16(b)).

other_items.label: No open construction permits
other_items.detail: Open construction permits must be closed.

other_items.label: Township trash and recycling containers
other_items.detail: Township-issued trash and recycle containers are required to be on the premises.

other_items.label: As-is sale buyer letter
other_items.detail: For homes sold 'as is', the buyer signs a notarized letter agreeing to finish required repairs within 60 days; a Settlement Document is issued when the letter is received.
